relations_to.summary: The 'Terror-Free Türkiye' process aims at the PKK's disbandment and disarmament: Öcalan called on the group in Feb 2025 to disarm, the PKK said in May 2025 it would end its armed struggle and dissolve, and a parliamentary commission set up in August 2025 recommended legislation; Law No. 7595 passed on 10 Aug 2026 (468 of 600 votes, with DEM and CHP support reported) and sets conditional suspensions of sentences.

sources.title: Turkish parliament passes landmark law to advance PKK peace process
